entities.name: Query beta-lactamase
observations: 306 aa protein with an N-terminal secretion signal peptide-like hydrophobic segment; predicted mature enzyme is approximately 27 kDa after signal-peptide removal.
Exact full-length sequence match to reviewed UniProt P10424 from Bacillus cereus; annotated as secreted beta-lactamase 1 acting preferentially on penicillins.
Contains Pfam Beta-lactamase PF00144 and Beta-lactamase2 PF13354 domains across approximately residues 51-304.
Predicted molecular weight is 33.6 kDa for the precursor and theoretical pI is 8.85.

entities.name: Beta-lactam hydrolysis
observations: EC 3.5.2.6; beta-lactam plus water yields a substituted beta-amino acid. Rhea RHEA:20401.
For this protein family, the biologically relevant substrates are preferentially penicillin-class beta-lactam antibiotics.

entities.name: Beta-lactam antibiotic catabolism
observations: The curated reference annotation assigns this activity to beta-lactam antibiotic catabolic process and response to antibiotic.

entities.name: Extracellular region
observations: Reviewed reference P10424 is annotated as secreted and localized to the extracellular region; the query N-terminus is consistent with Sec-dependent export.
